note: RFC 7440 Section 4: 'The notified DSND SHOULD send a new data block window whose beginning MUST be set based on the ACK received out of sequence.' TestRFC7440ServerInWindowACKRestartsWindow, windowsize 4: blocks 1-4 sent, ACK 2 must draw exactly 3-6 before the 5 s timeout would (red on a restart from 1 or 5, or on waiting for the timeout); a repeated ACK 2 (the block before the window, a duplicate under RFC 1350 Section 5) and ACK 20 (never sent) draw no DATA; ACK 6 then draws 7-10. Producer serveFile first = acked + 1 with awaitACK's windowPosition.
